seo.title: Edit PDF Metadata — Free & Secure | JDpdf
seo.description: Edit a PDF's title, author, subject, and keywords. Free, fast, and private.

subtitle: Change the title, author, subject, and keywords stored inside a PDF file.

options.hint: Leave a field blank to keep its current value.

howItWorks.title: How to edit a PDF's metadata
steps: Upload the PDF file you want to edit.
Fill in any of the title, author, subject, or keyword fields.
Click Save metadata and download the result.

items.a: Yes, editing PDF metadata is free within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: What happens to fields I leave blank?
items.a: Any field left blank keeps the file's existing value — you only need to fill in what you want to change.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
